s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent syncope with palpitations and transient loss of consciousness
salient_findings: Syncope with preceding palpitation and amaurosis
Polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during presyncope episode
Diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD and mid-right coronary artery
key_facts: 50-year-old male patient
Experienced syncope 30 minutes before admission
Reported palpitation and amaurosis before loss of consciousness
Previous episode of syncope 1 month prior
Diabetes, well controlled with medication
Vital signs: blood pressure 125/96 mm Hg, pulse rate 81 beats/min, respiratory rate 18 breaths/min, and oxygen saturation 99% under ambient air
Normal physical examination results
Normal laboratory tests, including blood glucose, electrolytes, D-dimer, troponin I, and N-terminal pro–B-type natriuretic peptide
Normal electrocardiogram and transthoracic echocardiography
Abnormal 12-lead 24-hour Holter monitoring with polymorphic ventricular tachycardia and QTc of 403 milliseconds
Coronary Angiography showed 50% to 90% diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD and 80% stenosis in mid-right coronary artery

raw.rationale: The patient experienced syncope with preceding palpitation and amaurosis, and the 12-lead 24-hour Holter monitoring recorded polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during a presyncope episode, which is consistent with catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia.

rejected.label: Long QT syndrome
rejected.why: The QTc interval of 403 milliseconds is within the normal range for most adults, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Coronary artery disease
rejected.why: While the patient has significant coronary artery stenosis, the symptoms and Holter monitoring results suggest an arrhythmic cause of syncope rather than an ischemic one.

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: There is no mention of right ventricular dysfunction or structural abnormalities on the transthoracic echocardiography.

rejected.label: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: The transthoracic echocardiography showed a normal left ventricular ejection fraction and no mention of hypertrophy.

rejected.label: Brugada syndrome
rejected.why: The electrocardiogram was initially normal, and there is no mention of the characteristic Brugada pattern.

rejected.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of cardiac sarcoidosis on the provided tests and examinations.

rejected.label: Myocardial bridging
rejected.why: While the coronary angiography showed significant stenosis, there is no specific mention of myocardial bridging as a cause of the patient's symptoms.
